# The Living Protocol

> A generational wellness operating system — long-term health intelligence that tracks, adapts, and compounds across decades.

## What it is
The Living Protocol is a generational wellness operating system being built at VaultSpark Studios. It is a long-term health intelligence layer designed to track, adapt, and compound wellness data across decades and generations — health intelligence that compounds like interest. Free Vault Members receive early development signals and concept previews. VaultSparked members receive first-wave priority access when testing opens.

## Current focus
In the forge — foundational concept and architecture phase. No public release date set.

## Next milestone
Concept validation and first design prototypes, shared first with VaultSparked members before any public announcement.
